thickness_sampling: all triangle centroids inward normal rays, not vertex baking
uv_metric: tangent deformation singular values relative to Basis; scale=max(abs(s-1)); anisotropy=smax/smin-1

shader_correction.contract: candidate t(UV,w)=t_base(UV)+sum(w_i*c_i(UV)); errors below are measured, not acceptance; no claim for combined morphs
shader_correction.indexing: coefficient array indexed by source mesh loop-triangle, same UV as thickness.png
shader_correction.maps_required_in_D: bake each coefficient field to signed texture array or shader-readable atlas; fit is evidence only
shader_correction.acceptance: D must independently compare integrated shader with ray reference, including clipping and alpha
